main.description: Create an ephemeral clip from a streamer's live broadcast. Grabs the last N milliseconds from the streamer's moderation buffer, muxes it into a temporary MP4, and creates a VOD draft pre-filled with the muxed content. The clipper has 10 minutes to edit and publish before the ephemeral file is deleted. Requires the streamer to have clipping enabled (livestreamClipping setting). Rate-limited per viewer and per stream.

streamer.description: The DID of the streamer whose live broadcast is being clipped.

durationMs.description: Duration of content to grab from the buffer, in milliseconds. Defaults to 60 seconds. Maximum is the buffer window (120 seconds).

clipId.description: ID of the created ephemeral clip. Pass to place.stream.clip.publish within 10 minutes.

previewUrl.description: URL to the ephemeral MP4 for preview in the clip editor. Valid until expiresAt.

expiresAt.description: When the ephemeral clip file and draft will be deleted. Always 10 minutes from creation.

durationMs.description: Actual duration of the muxed content, in milliseconds. May be less than requested if the buffer had fewer segments.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.description: The request lacks valid authentication credentials.

errors.name: ClippingDisabled
errors.description: The streamer has disabled clipping for their broadcasts.

errors.name: RateLimited
errors.description: The viewer or stream has exceeded the clip rate limit.

errors.name: NotLive
errors.description: The streamer is not currently broadcasting.

errors.name: NoContent
errors.description: No segments were available in the moderation buffer to clip.
